grid.formula: 0 dry; 1..127 liquid, 128..254 frozen: mm/h = 10^(-1 + (code-base)/126 * log10(500)) with base 1 (liquid) or 128 (frozen); 255 no data
grid.resolution_note: log steps of about 5% (display image is palette-compressed; values come from the grid)
